description: Source code for the HTTPMultipartUpload class, implementing multipart HTTP upload functionality with compatibility for different iOS and macOS SDK versions.

classes.name: HTTPMultipartUpload
classes.description: A class for constructing and sending multipart HTTP POST requests, including file uploads and form data.

methods.name: multipartBoundary
methods.description: Generates a unique boundary string for multipart form data.

methods.name: formDataForKey:value:
methods.description: Creates form data for a key-value pair.

methods.name: formDataForFileContents:name:
methods.description: Creates form data for file contents with a given name.

methods.name: formDataForFile:name:
methods.description: Creates form data for a file at a given path with a specified name.

methods.name: initWithURL:
methods.description: Initializes the upload object with a target URL.

methods.name: setParameters:
methods.description: Sets additional form parameters for the upload.

methods.name: addFileAtPath:name:
methods.description: Adds a file to be uploaded from a specified path.

methods.name: addFileContents:name:
methods.description: Adds file data to be uploaded with a specified name.

methods.name: send:
methods.description: Performs the multipart upload, returning the response data.

methods.name: response
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response after sending the request.
